function.name: run_reconstructor
function.description: Run one reconstructor preset on this window (each can be run once). Returns its ranked candidate paths with observable diagnostics. Presets: beam (speed+steering beam search, 10 candidates), beam_wide (beam 500, 20 candidates), beam_loose (looser heading/turn tolerances), pf, pf_s1, pf_s2, pf_s3, pf_s4 (particle filter, one lineage each, different seeds), ep (Elastic Pathing with heading, speed only), ep_hm (Elastic Pathing without heading).

function.name: inspect_candidate
function.description: Full diagnostics of one candidate you have seen: heading consistency, turn matching, dead-reckoning distance in the first 60 and 120 s, junction-level agreement, end position, overlap with other run tools' Top-1 and divergence points.

function.name: compare_candidates
function.description: Side-by-side diagnostics of 2 to 4 candidates you have seen, and for every pair the first point where they diverge: distance, the turn each takes there, the dead-reckoned heading change at that moment and the road junction (exits) nearest to it.

function.name: score_candidates
function.description: Probability that each listed candidate (which you have seen) recovers the route, from a statistical model fitted on validation drives over the same diagnostics.

function.name: query_local_graph
function.description: Road junction nearest to a given distance along a candidate you have seen: arrival heading, exits (relative turn, length, road class, one-way), which exit the candidate took, and the dead-reckoned heading change around that moment.

function.name: submit_choice
function.description: Final answer: the id of one candidate you have seen. The program outputs that candidate's full trajectory.
